name: MH3G #28 Switch Axe player-state snapshot
purpose_zh: 在通用玩家每帧路径 0x0289248C 捕获 r7 玩家状态前 0x800 字节，用五个同生命周期快照筛选斩斧 0..100 能量字段。该断点只证明对象快照，不证明能量 writer，也不修改内存。
purpose_en: Capture the first 0x800 bytes of r7 player state at generic per-frame path 0x0289248C and use five same-lifecycle snapshots to isolate the 0..100 Switch Axe energy field. This breakpoint proves only the object snapshot, not the energy writer, and never modifies memory.
operator_steps_zh: 关闭所有 Graphic Pack，尤其是 #007、#25 和任何武器/速度修改；冷启动同一 JP v96 游戏进程，装备斩斧并进入不会换区的安全任务区域。
能量完全充满且保持稳定时运行一次 tracer，保存为 full.jsonl。断点每次只取一个快照并自动恢复游戏。
保持同一 Cemu 进程、任务、区域、装备和角色生命周期；进入剑模式，制造两个清晰递减的能量状态，各暂停操作后立即独立运行 tracer，保存 consume-1.jsonl 与 consume-2.jsonl。
切回斧模式等待自然回充，在两个严格递增且尚未换区的时点分别运行 tracer，保存 recharge-1.jsonl 与 recharge-2.jsonl。
用 analyze-switch-axe-snapshots.py 同时分析五个文件。只有同一 r7 基址、0..100 标度和完整 100>消耗1>消耗2<回充1<回充2 序列才进入 writer 定位；否则重新采样，不生成 Pack。
operator_steps_en: Disable every Graphic Pack, especially #007, #25, and all weapon or speed modifiers. Cold-start the same JP-v96 process, equip a Switch Axe, and enter a safe quest area without changing zones.
Run one tracer at a stable full gauge and save full.jsonl. Each run takes one snapshot and resumes the title automatically.

Keep the same Cemu process, quest, area, equipment, and player lifecycle. Enter sword mode, produce two clearly decreasing gauge states, and immediately run independent traces saved as consume-1.jsonl and consume-2.jsonl.
Return to axe mode for natural recharge and capture two strictly increasing points without changing areas, saved as recharge-1.jsonl and recharge-2.jsonl.

Analyze all five files with analyze-switch-axe-snapshots.py. Proceed to writer tracing only when the r7 base is identical, the scale is 0..100, and the full 100 > consume1 > consume2 < recharge1 < recharge2 sequence holds; otherwise recapture and do not create a Pack.
